title: Conditioning Charges Raised on Grain Held Under a Storage Agreement
content:
The member pays for the water the dryer takes out, and a pass is charged as soon as it has been run. This entry governs conditioning charges on Grain Storage and Conditioning Agreements.

## What the entry covers

A pass of a member's stored grain through the dryer is priced by the desk and recorded against the agreement the grain is held under, naming the moisture the grain went into the dryer at and came out at, the points of moisture taken out, the bushels the pass was run on and the money charged for it. The line goes onto the storage account standing unpaid, so the charge joins what the member owes the elevator at once. Bushels on hand are not moved by the charge and no shrink is taken by it; the grade of record and the standing of the agreement are left exactly as they are.

## Recording the charge

The recording tool is `charge_drying_pass_a57b52cd`. It is a hidden tool of the elevator's own: the desk unlocks it and then calls it itself, the dryer being the cooperative's plant and the charge the cooperative's write.

### Parameters

| Parameter | What it is | Form |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `agreement_id` | the internal reference number of the storage agreement the grain is held under | as returned by the storage agreement lookup for this member |
| `moisture_in_pct` | the moisture the grain stood at when the pass began | a percentage to 1 decimal place, rounded half up at the first decimal |
| `moisture_out_pct` | the moisture the grain was left at when the pass ended | a percentage to 1 decimal place, rounded half up at the first decimal |
| `points_removed` | the moisture taken out by this pass | percentage points to 1 decimal place, rounded half up at the first decimal, never negative |
| `bushels` | the quantity the pass was run on | bushels to 2 decimal places, rounded half up at the second decimal |
| `amount` | the money charged for the pass | USD to 2 decimal places, rounded half up at the cent, always positive on a charge |

### What comes back

A single line of confirmation text carrying the new storage account line's own reference, the moisture readings in and out, the points taken out, the bushels run and the amount charged in USD to 2 decimal places. Receiving that line means the conditioning charge stands on the member's storage account, unpaid, and that no other line was written.

## Points of judgement

**Does the charge move the bushels?** It does not. The line is money on the storage account; what is held in store is untouched by it.

**Does the charge change the grade of record?** No. The grade the agreement stands at and the standing of the agreement are both left as they are.
